verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird publishes jurisdiction-specific startup materials. These include a UK Enterprise Management Incentive (EMI) factsheet with related UK share-plan factsheets, a free German Term Sheet Generator for early financing rounds in Germany, and the TwoVenture guidance hub for start-ups. Coverage is evidenced only for the UK and Germany, and even then only for some instruments. Missing for 10: German VSOP content, Indian FDI/ESOP publications, French BSPCE publications, depth of the EMI content beyond a download listing, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm publishes on jurisdiction-specific startup instruments and rules of my market — e.g. UK EMI schemes, German VSOPs, Indian FDI/ESOP rules, French BSPCE

citations.quote: automate the production of a simplified Term Sheet for early financing rounds in Germany
A hub to provide guidance to start-up and scale-up companies and their investors through the venture capital life cycle
